summary: Varangian civ and the top ranked 1v1 win rate right now. Macedonians open on deer, take the Hippodrome in Feudal around 2:45, build Varangian Strongholds and reach Castle around 12 with Riddari cavalry.
openings: Deer opener into the Hippodrome at about 2:45, then Varangian Strongholds.
Castle around 12 via the Golden Horn Tower, which trains free crossbowmen, with Riddari cavalry joining in Castle.

spikes.label: Early Varangian Guard
spikes.detail: Early Varangian Guards come in Feudal and hit very hard.
spikes.answer: Archers and towers; avoid melee fights.

spikes.label: Castle cavalry
spikes.detail: Riddari cavalry arrive around Castle at 12 minutes, backed by free crossbowmen from the Golden Horn Tower.
spikes.answer: Spearmen and archers; English pros switch to cavalry of their own.

spikes.label: Siege death-push
spikes.detail: Against slow-scaling civs they build a big siege push around 24 minutes.
spikes.answer: Have your own siege and an army to defend by the mid 20s.

scout: Silver building up at Mining Camps

winConditions.detail: An upgraded Varangian army and a late siege push.

howToBeat: Rus skip Pro Scouts against them.
